senses.gloss: f.(b. h. circle, turn; crown; צָפַר, v. צְפַר II)

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:10:6">Y. Erub. I, end, 19ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <he>ויצפר</he>, <cite ref="Judges 7:3">Jud. VII, 3</cite>) <he>ולמה הן חוזרין בצ׳</he> and why were they to go home on a circuitous route?

senses.gloss: circle, suite of body-guards. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 3; Yalk. Ex. 244 מלך … ועליו צ׳ מקיפתו וכ׳ a king that enters a city, and about him is a circle of guards that surrounds him, and his mighty men &c.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 5</cite> <he>סרוד של צ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="R00685"><he>צפורה</he></cite>) a frame with a rim (of plaited ropes &c.), if it has handles, is susceptible of uncleanness.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:3">Kel. XVI, 3</cite> <he>משיעשה בו צ׳ אחת</he> as soon as he has woven around it one round (as a rim); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 13</cite> <he>צבירה אחת חוץ מזה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) one round besides the rims of the web itself.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:2:3">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ</cite> top <he>באילין קשייא כדי לעשות צ׳</he> of hard palm-leaves (used for ropes, v. <cite ref="A02764"><he>אַפְסְקִימָא</he></cite>) as many as are required to make a border; a. e.—Pl. <he>צְפִירוֹת</he>. Kel. l. c.; Tosef. l. c. <he>צבירות</he> (corr. acc.).
